diagnostic_runs_lifecycle_check.name: diagnostic_runs_lifecycle_check
diagnostic_runs_lifecycle_check.value: ("diagnostic_runs"."status" = 'COMPLETED' and "diagnostic_runs"."completed_at" is not null) or ("diagnostic_runs"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' and "diagnostic_runs"."completed_at" is null)

full_mock_runs_mode_sections_check.name: full_mock_runs_mode_sections_check
full_mock_runs_mode_sections_check.value: ("full_mock_runs"."mode"='LISTENING' and "full_mock_runs"."listening_started_at" is not null and "full_mock_runs"."listening_deadline" is not null and "full_mock_runs"."reading_started_at" is null and "full_mock_runs"."reading_deadline" is null) or ("full_mock_runs"."mode"='READING' and "full_mock_runs"."listening_started_at" is null and "full_mock_runs"."listening_deadline" is null and "full_mock_runs"."reading_started_at" is not null and "full_mock_runs"."reading_deadline" is not null) or ("full_mock_runs"."mode"='FULL' and "full_mock_runs"."listening_started_at" is not null and "full_mock_runs"."listening_deadline" is not null)

learner_goals_target_score_check.name: learner_goals_target_score_check
learner_goals_target_score_check.value: "learner_goals"."target_score" is null or ("learner_goals"."target_score" between 10 and 990 and "learner_goals"."target_score" % 5 = 0)

media_assets_owner_scope_check.name: media_assets_owner_scope_check
media_assets_owner_scope_check.value: ("media_assets"."access_scope" = 'CONTENT' and "media_assets"."owner_user_id" is null) or ("media_assets"."access_scope" = 'PRIVATE_USER' and "media_assets"."owner_user_id" is not null)

passage_sets_skill_part_check.name: passage_sets_skill_part_check
passage_sets_skill_part_check.value: ("passage_sets"."skill_area" = 'LISTENING' and "passage_sets"."toeic_part" between 1 and 4) or ("passage_sets"."skill_area" = 'READING' and "passage_sets"."toeic_part" between 5 and 7)

practice_sessions_one_open_practice_idx.name: practice_sessions_one_open_practice_idx
practice_sessions_one_open_practice_idx.where: "practice_sessions"."status" = 'in_progress' and "practice_sessions"."practice_type" <> 'demo_test' and "practice_sessions"."source" not in ('diagnostic','full_mock','ranked_challenge') and "practice_sessions"."user_id" is not null

practice_sessions_diagnostic_link_check.name: practice_sessions_diagnostic_link_check
practice_sessions_diagnostic_link_check.value: ("practice_sessions"."source" = 'diagnostic' and "practice_sessions"."diagnostic_run_id" is not null and "practice_sessions"."diagnostic_order" between 1 and 7) or ("practice_sessions"."source" <> 'diagnostic' and "practice_sessions"."diagnostic_run_id" is null and "practice_sessions"."diagnostic_order" is null)

practice_sessions_full_mock_link_check.name: practice_sessions_full_mock_link_check
practice_sessions_full_mock_link_check.value: ("practice_sessions"."source" = 'full_mock' and "practice_sessions"."full_mock_run_id" is not null and "practice_sessions"."full_mock_order" between 1 and 7 and "practice_sessions"."user_id" is not null and "practice_sessions"."guest_owner_hash" is null) or ("practice_sessions"."source" <> 'full_mock' and "practice_sessions"."full_mock_run_id" is null and "practice_sessions"."full_mock_order" is null)

practice_sessions_ranked_challenge_link_.name: practice_sessions_ranked_challenge_link_check
practice_sessions_ranked_challenge_link_.value: ("practice_sessions"."source"='ranked_challenge' and "practice_sessions"."ranked_challenge_run_id" is not null and "practice_sessions"."ranked_challenge_order" between 1 and 7 and "practice_sessions"."user_id" is not null and "practice_sessions"."guest_owner_hash" is null) or ("practice_sessions"."source"<>'ranked_challenge' and "practice_sessions"."ranked_challenge_run_id" is null and "practice_sessions"."ranked_challenge_order" is null)

practice_sessions_demo_time_check.name: practice_sessions_demo_time_check
practice_sessions_demo_time_check.value: ("practice_sessions"."practice_type" = 'demo_test' and "practice_sessions"."guest_owner_hash" is null and "practice_sessions"."expires_at" > "practice_sessions"."started_at" and (("practice_sessions"."status" = 'in_progress' and "practice_sessions"."submission_reason" is null) or ("practice_sessions"."status" = 'submitted' and "practice_sessions"."submission_reason" in ('manual','time_expired')) or "practice_sessions"."status" = 'abandoned')) or ("practice_sessions"."practice_type" <> 'demo_test' and (("practice_sessions"."guest_owner_hash" is not null and "practice_sessions"."expires_at" > "practice_sessions"."started_at") or ("practice_sessions"."guest_owner_hash" is null and ("practice_sessions"."expires_at" is null or "practice_sessions"."source" in ('diagnostic','full_mock','ranked_challenge')))) and (("practice_sessions"."status" = 'submitted' and "practice_sessions"."submission_reason" in ('mock_section_complete','ranked_section_complete')) or ("practice_sessions"."status" <> 'submitted' and "practice_sessions"."submission_reason" is null)))

practice_sessions_skill_part_check.name: practice_sessions_skill_part_check
practice_sessions_skill_part_check.value: ("practice_sessions"."skill_area" = 'READING' and ("practice_sessions"."part" is null or "practice_sessions"."part" between 5 and 7)) or ("practice_sessions"."skill_area" = 'LISTENING' and ("practice_sessions"."part" is null or "practice_sessions"."part" between 1 and 4))

questions_skill_part_check.name: questions_skill_part_check
questions_skill_part_check.value: ("questions"."skill_area" = 'LISTENING' and "questions"."toeic_part" between 1 and 4) or ("questions"."skill_area" = 'READING' and "questions"."toeic_part" between 5 and 7)

ranked_challenge_runs_scores_check.name: ranked_challenge_runs_scores_check
ranked_challenge_runs_scores_check.value: ("ranked_challenge_runs"."listening_score" is null or "ranked_challenge_runs"."listening_score" between 0 and 100) and ("ranked_challenge_runs"."reading_score" is null or "ranked_challenge_runs"."reading_score" between 0 and 100) and ("ranked_challenge_runs"."total_score" is null or "ranked_challenge_runs"."total_score" between 0 and 200)
